name: Hesk Stonecount
role: Delvewarden of Longdelve: keeps the nine-hundred-year tunnel's heading and the stone calendar the Hourkeepers trust
appearance: Grey-braided, spectacled, chalk on her fingers, and a measuring rod she uses as a walking stick and occasionally as an argument.
voiceHints: Speaks slowly and in round numbers of centuries. Corrects your dates.
wants: To see the tunnel reach whatever it was dug toward, and to know what that was.
fears: That the founders' heading was wrong.
knowledge: The Delve's heading, to the finger's breadth
Which Hourkeeper calendars disagree with the stone one, and by how much

reactsToReputation.patient: talks to you as an equal
reactsToReputation.hasty: answers in centuries until you go away

questSeeds: The tunnel's end is three years away and the founders' notes about what lies there are missing
An Hourkeeper wants the stone calendar moved to the Kept Reach
title: Delvewarden of Longdelve

physicality: ADULT, past middle age. Small, grey-braided, spectacled. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: chalk on her fingers and a brass measuring rod.

abilities.why: names the remaining time on anything already running
nine hundred years of digging is a long watch
strikes when you cannot answer, rarely
mason secondary: reads the tunnel face by touch
feels a collapse before it comes
syllogist tertiary: a dig is a proof, and she closes the argument
knows what the next yard of tunnel costs

intimacyNotes: NOT AVAILABLE: widowed forty years, and the Delve is the only thing she is still married to.
